behavior: An open Popover can have no popup part, and an open Navigation Menu can have no viewport. A consumer can remove the part with `v-if`, or the part can be an async component that has not loaded. The Tab key then skips the popup, as it skips a popup with no tabbable element. Shift+Tab moves the focus from the element after `Popover.Trigger` to the trigger, and it asks for no close. Tab moves the focus from an active `NavigationMenu.Trigger` to the next tabbable element, and Shift+Tab moves it from that element to the trigger. Tab from `NavigationMenu.Trigger` closes the item with the reason `focus-out` in the cases where Tab from the end of a viewport closes it. In Base UI, Shift+Tab from the element after the trigger of such a Popover focuses that element again. Tab from an active `NavigationMenu.Trigger` with no viewport focuses that trigger again, and Shift+Tab from the next trigger focuses the next trigger again.
